upload.dragHint: Drag files or folders from your computer here to upload them.

selection.label: Selection
selection.tooManyZip: Too many entries for one ZIP; download the folder instead.
selection.tooManyScan: Too many entries for one virus scan; scan the folder instead.

scan.results: The results appear on the Virus scan tab.

truncated: This folder has more entries than the panel shows. Use SFTP to see all of them.
unnamed_one: {{count}} entry has a name that is not valid UTF-8 and is not shown. Rename it over SFTP.
unnamed_other: {{count}} entries have names that are not valid UTF-8 and are not shown. Rename them over SFTP.
empty: This folder is empty. Drop files here to upload them.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.intoHint: A path in the site's home, for example htdocs/old. Empty is the home itself.
dialog.modeHint: Octal, for example 644 for files and 755 for folders. Applies to the entries themselves, not to their content.
dialog.deleteText: Folders are deleted with their content. There is no recycle bin; backups are the way back.
dialog.badPath: Enter a path without “..”, “.” or empty parts.

done.copiedSkipped_one: Copied to {{where}}. {{count}} special file was left out.
done.copiedSkipped_other: Copied to {{where}}. {{count}} special files were left out.

check.nameSpace: The name must not start or end with a space.
check.nameLong: The name is longer than 255 bytes.
check.modeDigits: Enter three or four octal digits, for example 644.
check.modeSpecial: setuid, setgid and the sticky bit cannot be set here.

errors.unreachable: The file manager could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.files_not_found: It is not there any more. Reload the folder.
errors.files_exists: An entry with this name exists already.
errors.files_changed: The file changed since it was opened.
errors.files_symlink: Symlinks are shown but not followed here. Use SFTP for them.
errors.files_not_file: This is not a regular file.
errors.files_into_itself: A folder cannot be moved or copied into itself.
errors.files_no_space: The site's disk limit is reached. Free space first or raise the limit.
errors.files_denied: The site user may not change this entry.
errors.files_too_large: This is too large for the file manager ({{detail}}).
errors.files_unavailable: The file manager did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.files_stopped: The extraction stopped without a result.

editor.notText: This file is not UTF-8 text and cannot be edited here. Download it instead.
editor.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MiB and cannot be edited here. Download it instead.
editor.changed: The file was changed by someone else since it was opened. Copy your changes, close the editor and open the file again.
editor.askText: The changes to {{name}} are not saved.
